name: synthetic-submit-envelope-error
description: SYNTHETIC: the create-task call answers HTTP 200 with a NON-ZERO envelope code (1102, resource pack exhausted — the v1 test shape). Kling documents every error as a non-2xx, so this is an upstream error dressed as success: no task id, nothing to poll, settled as OUR synthesized 502 with providerHttpStatus 200 (design D6), zero-billed.
